description: Declaration invariants in both forms — after a declaration's closer (with `renders` between clauses) and after a `type :struct` body — whose literals keep them, compile and run; a clause may call a pure `fn` that computes only from its arguments (through another `fn`) and a deterministic built-in (`.every(x => …)`).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rules 1-2: several clauses and `renders` follow the closer in either order; rule 7 (r1, prov=pa-ruled:S483-fn-chain-purity and prov=pa-ruled:S483-direct-equals-fn-purity): a pure `fn` chain that reads only its arguments and a deterministic built-in method are admitted.
